newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Better tax collection to boost Portugal revenue.
newsitem.headline: Better tax collection to boost Portugal revenue.

text.p: Improved tax collection efficiency will bring in 110 billion escudos of revenues, equivalent to 2.9 percent of total expected tax revenues in 1997, according to details of the budget presented to parliament.
The document said that in 1996 improved tax collection efficiency brought in revenues equivalent to 2.3 percent of total tax revenues.

Revenues from income tax (IRS) were expected to increase by 9.9 percent year-on-year to 1,107.3 billion escudos and revenues from corporate tax (IRC) were expected to rise by 15.8 percent year-on-year to 590.8 billion escudos in 1997, it said.
The government has pledged to crack down on widespread tax evasion to boost revenues in its bid to meet entry targets for joining a single European currency.
